name: index-options-scenario-stress
notes: A hypothetical same-expiry, European cash-settled index condor. Full Black-76 repricing shows each declared price/volatility/time/rate scenario and the worst loss among them. Every number is synthetic; these marks are not fills, margin or a trading decision. Run from this child: python -m dskit.pipeline run configs/run-option-scenario-stress.json --asof 2026-10-26.

scenarios.name: unchanged
scenarios.notes: Zero-shock control: hypothetical P&L must be zero.

scenarios.name: down_5_vol_up_5
scenarios.notes: A one-day selloff with every leg's IV five percentage points higher.

scenarios.name: down_12_vol_up_15
scenarios.notes: A deliberately severe joint price and volatility shock.

scenarios.name: up_10_vol_down_5
scenarios.notes: Tests the other wing and falling volatility.

scenarios.name: expiry_down_15
scenarios.notes: All legs expire and are valued at intrinsic payoff; a separate terminal scenario.

scenario_stress.notes: Shocks act on the stated forward and leg IVs; the worst is only the worst declared scenario, with no probability or coverage claim. Change the book and scenarios in this JSON to explore another hypothetical position.
